title: A Versatile Variational Quantum Kernel Framework for Non-Trivial Classification
abstract: arXiv:2511.10831v3 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Quantum kernel methods are a promising branch of quantum machine learning, but their per- formance across data types and encoding choices remains incompletely understood. To address this gap, we developed an algorithmic framework for variational quantum kernels utilizing resource- efficient ans\"atze for complex classification tasks and introduced a parameter scaling technique to accelerate convergence. We conducted a comprehensive benchmark of this framework on eight chal- lenging, real-world and high-dimensional datasets covering tabular, image, time series, and graph data. Our results show that the proposed quantum kernel demonstrated competitive classification accuracy compared to standard classical kernels in classical simulation, such as the radial basis function (RBF) kernel. translated_title: 面向非平凡分类任务的多功能变分量子核框架
translated_abstract: 量子核方法是量子机器学习中一个具有前景的分支，但其在不同数据类型和编码选择下的性能仍未被充分理解。为填补这一空白，我们开发了一个用于变分量子核的算法框架，该框架利用资源高效的拟设（ansätze）来处理复杂分类任务，并引入了一种参数缩放技术以加速收敛。我们在八个具有挑战性的真实世界高维数据集上对该框架进行了全面基准测试，这些数据集涵盖表格数据、图像、时间序列和图数据。结果表明，在经典模拟中，所提出的量子核相比标准经典核（如径向基函数（RBF）核）展现出具有竞争力的分类准确率。这项工作证明，经过合理设计的量子核可以作为多功能、高性能的工具，为量子增强的机器学习奠定基础。
tldr: 该研究提出了一个结合资源高效拟设与参数缩放技术的多功能变分量子核框架，在涵盖表格、图像、时间序列和图数据的八个真实高维数据集上取得了与经典RBF核相当的分类性能。
en_tdlr: This work proposes a versatile variational quantum kernel framework with resource-efficient ansätze and a parameter scaling technique, achieving classification accuracy competitive with classical RBF kernels across eight real-world high-dimensional datasets spanning tabular, image, time series, and graph data.
